Density plot of pairwise ASV identities across VSEARCH clustering thresholds

Source: R/cluster_fun.R
plot_pairwise_identity_vsearch.Rd

Generates density plots of pairwise ASV sequence identities within and between clusters obtained using VSEARCH clustering across a range of identity thresholds.

Usage

plot_pairwise_identity_vsearch(
  read_count,
  identity_min = 0.9,
  identity_max = 0.99,
  identity_increment = 0.01,
  min_id = 0.8,
  vsearch_path = NULL,
  num_threads = 0,
  outfile = "",
  plotfile = "",
  sep = ",",
  quiet = TRUE,
  log_file = NULL
)

Arguments

read_count

Data frame or CSV file containing the following columns: asv, sample, replicate (optional), read_count.

identity_min

Numeric value between 0 and 1. Minimum clustering identity threshold.

identity_max

Numeric value between 0 and 1. Maximum clustering identity threshold.

identity_increment

Numeric value between 0 and 1. Step size used to vary clustering identity thresholds from identity_min to identity_max.

min_id

Numeric value between 0 and 1. Minimum pairwise identity; ASV pairs below this threshold are excluded from alignment and plotting.

vsearch_path

Optional path to the vsearch executable. If NULL (default), resolved via getOption("vtamR.vsearch_path") or the PATH (see get_path).

num_threads

Positive integer: number of CPUs to use. If 0, all available CPUs are used.

outfile

Character string: name of the output CSV file containing pairwise_asv_identity, cluster assignment, and clustering parameter. If empty, no file is written.

plotfile

Character string: name of the output PNG file for the plot. If empty, no file is written.

sep

Field separator character used in input and output CSV files.

quiet

Logical: if TRUE, suppress informational messages and display only warnings or errors.

log_file

Character string specifying the path to the CSV log file. The path is resolved with the following priority:

  1. the log_file argument, if explicitly provided by the user;

  2. the vtamR.log_file option set with options(vtamR.log_file = ...), if set;

  3. "vtamR_log.csv" in the current working directory, used as a last resort if neither of the above is set.

To disable logging entirely, set log_file = NA.

Value

A density plot of pairwise ASV identity distributions across clustering thresholds.

Details

ASVs are clustered using the VSEARCH --cluster_size algorithm for each identity threshold between identity_min and identity_max. For each clustering result, pairwise ASV identities are computed and visualized as density distributions, separating within-cluster and between-cluster comparisons.

Identity values below min_id are excluded from the analysis and are not plotted.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot <- plot_pairwise_identity_vsearch(
  read_count_df,
  identity_min = 0.9,
  identity_max = 0.99,
  identity_increment = 0.01,
  min_id = 0.8,
  num_threads = 8,
  plotfile = "density_plot.png"
)
} # }
